persona_snapshot.name: Angry customer who feels wronged
persona_snapshot.summary: Feels cheated by billing and expects an apology before anything else.
persona_snapshot.speaking_style: Loud and sharp. Repeats the complaint, says "unbelievable" and "this is ridiculous", and threatens to take their business elsewhere. Never swears.

scenario_snapshot.title: Domain renewal before expiry
scenario_snapshot.description: A domain expires in a week with auto renew off. The bot should quote the price, confirm, then renew.
scenario_snapshot.goal: You got a notice that your domain is about to expire, and you want to renew it for one year.

beats.instruction: Say you got an expiry notice and want to renew your domain.
beats.checkpoint: The caller asked to renew the domain.

beats.instruction: Give your domain, then your billing zip and PIN when asked.
Ask how much it is, and say yes to one year on the card on file.
beats.checkpoint: The caller approved a one year renewal.

beats.instruction: Ask for the new expiry date.
beats.checkpoint: The caller asked for the new expiry date.

must.text: Quote $14.99 and get a yes before renewing.
State the new expiry date of November 6, 2027.

must_not.text: Renew for more than one year.

expected_state.description: The domain runs one more year.
